auth_details: API key via x-api-key header, self-serve signup
free_tier_limits: $20 free credits on signup (~2,800 searches) + $10 free credits/month; no payment method required
rate_limits: Default: /search 10 QPS, /contents 100 QPS, /answer 10 QPS; higher via Enterprise (exa.ai/docs/reference/rate-limits)
example_request: curl -X POST https://api.exa.ai/search -H "x-api-key: YOUR_API_KEY" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"query": "latest AI research"}'
description: Exa is a neural web search API that helps developers find relevant web pages and content using semantic search. It provides endpoints for searching, finding similar pages, and retrieving content from the web.
resolution_notes: Auditor was right: Exa has published pay-as-you-go endpoint pricing and Enterprise/custom plans. See https://exa.ai/pricing for details.
